name: The Farmer Wants a Wife
description: City meets the country in this fun-filled Australian series. Follow six lonely farmers on the road to romance as they choose between hundreds of prospective partners. Prepare for tears, joy, and jealousy, all in a heart-warming journey to find a wife. Hosted by Natalie Gruzlewski.

videos.title: Episode One
videos.overview: The premier episode of Season 2 begins with an introduction to our six farmer bachelors: Ben, Howie, James, Michael, Nick and Rob. Selected from farmers-applicants all over the country, these six are all ready to meet the girl of their dreams and settle down. In the first episode, each farmer chooses 10 women from his own shortlist to participate in a speed dating session. The farmers get to spend 5 minutes with each of the city girls, in which time he needs to decide whom he has a connection with. Only five of the girls can be selected to move on the next stage of proceedings: the group date.

videos.title: Episode Two
videos.overview: The second episode sees the six farmers take their five chosen city girls on a group date, in order to get to know each of the girls better. At the end of the group date, each farmer is expected to choose two girls with whom he has a connection, to invite back to his farm, where they will spend 10 days establishing the foundations for a potential relationship. Five of the six farmers: Rob, James, Howie, Ben and Nick chose two women they had a connection with to spend some time on their farms. However, Farmer Michael received an employment offer of some shearing work and, due to money concerns, reluctantly left the show to pursue the work opportunity.

videos.title: Episode Three
videos.overview: The third episode sees each farmer playing host to his two chosen women, when they come to visit at the farm. In the previous episode, each farmer narrowed their list of girls down to two, and these two women were then invited for a 10-day stay on their chosen farmer's property. Immediate attraction occurs for farmer Rob, but it is drama for Nick when one of his girls does not show up. Farmer James fails to impress his chosen ladies, Ben seems torn between both women and Howie has his own issues when one of his ladies has a problem with farm life. In a surprising twist, Michael decides to return to the show after the job opportunity of the previous episode fell through. His return sees a late invitation to his chosen women.

videos.title: Episode Four
videos.overview: Episode four sees life on the farm continuing as the farmers take time out from their regular chores to get to know each of the two women they invited back to their properties. One of the highlights of this part of the stay is the farmers' chance to introduce their chosen ladies to their family and/or friends. Nick takes his girls home to meet his mum and sister, who take a shine to outgoing Stephanie. Howie takes his girls to meet his friends but confesses privately that he has not felt a connection with either lady. James causes drama, and a heated confrontation with Toni, when he neglects both his ladies in order to party with his mates, Returned farmer Michael takes his ladies to the local pub, where he spends some one-on-one time with both girls. This week also sees only couple Rob and Jo's relationship hotting up as their feelings towards each other grow.

videos.title: Episode Five
videos.overview: This episode follows our farmers on their last days spent with their visiting ladies. For most of the farmers this is their last chance to spend some quality time with each woman before they head back to the city. Farmer Rob and Jo, who have already fallen for each other, take the opportunity this episode to confess to Rob's other choice, Emmaline, that they are now together. Nick and Steph seem to be getting things together after a romantic couple of days without Kristy. Howie confesses to both his girls that he hasn't developed feelings for either of them, leaving Karen broken-hearted. James is still creating drama with his two women, whereas Michael's attention now seems firmly focussed on Jenni. In a big twist, Farmer Ben confesses his feelings to Emma, only for Emma to turn around and declare that she doesn't feel strongly enough to pursue a relationship.

videos.title: Episode Six
videos.overview: The series final follows the six farmers as they travel to the city to knock on the door of the girl they have chosen, to see if she also wants to pursue a relationship. Rob travelled to Jo's door, and she soon introduced him to her parents. Ben knocked on Sarah's door and Michael visited Simone's house looking to pursue a relationship. James chose Toni as his potential lady, and Nick visited Kristy. As a bonus, this episode also presents a follow-up on our farmers to see where their love-lives are at now. Wedding bells seem to be ringing for love-struck couple Rob and Jo. Nick, in a shock decision, reveals that he has found love with Kristy. Ben and Sarah are also enjoying their developing relationship. Sadly, for the other three farmers, Howie, James and Michael, none of their chosen women turned out to be 'the one', and are all out searching for love again.

videos.title: Season 6, Episode 7

videos.title: Season 6, Reunion Special

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Australia's greatest love story has begun, so saddle-up, hop on and join us for the ride, because this series of Farmer Wants a Wife promises to be the most heart-warming yet. Once again we have six bush bachelors who are looking for love and someone to share their lives on the land with … but this year there's a twist in the tale! Episode one saw each farmer invite six city singles to the romantic Hunter Valley, in an attempt to find that special someone.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's a huge day for our six love-lost farmers with them putting the girls straight to work and beginning to sort out who's suited to life on the land. By dinner some farmers already have a favourite and the romance begins in earnest the following day when the one on one dates begin.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Our six farmers are settling into life with their three girls. Tomorrow they must send a girl home, so they are keen to make every moment count. Some have asked their family members to meet their three girls to help them with their tough decision. While for others love seems to be blossoming. But in a shocking turn of events one of the favourites decides to leave the farm and in the process leaves one of our farmers reeling.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Our farmers come face to face with one of the toughest decisions they will ever have to make. Today is the day they must ask one of their favourites to leave their farm forever. Difficult choices must be made but in the end they all will be closer to their happily ever after.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The farmers take a fresh approach to love. They are taking their favourites off the farm for romantic overnight dates. While love is defiantly in the air for some, for others competing for one farmer's heart proves too much to handle.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With only a matter of days left on the farm, everyone is feeling the pressure. The farmers and their favourites are putting their hearts on the line. As time runs out the competition for true love has never been tougher.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After an emotional farm stay our lonesome bush bachelors say goodbye to their two favourites. However before the farmers can make their final decisions they will need to visit each of their potential loves in their home cities, which means meeting the parents and families.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tonight a very special farmer event when we reveal the women that have stolen the hearts of our six lovely farmers. Plus, we take a walk down the aisle of our most remote farmer ever, Nathan who takes on loves ultimate commitment and marries his series five choice Amanda.

videos.title: Who's That Girl?

videos.title: Elimination

videos.overview: The girls are surprised by the news they must spend the day preparing a lavish meal for their farmer's parents. The girls get one chance to impress their farmer and their families before the farmer chooses another girl to send home.

videos.overview: The girl who the farmer needs to get to know better is off for a night with her farmer, leaving the other girl to her own devices to plot ways to get the spotlight back on her.

videos.overview: The episode begins with fallout from the 24-hour dream dates. It's the last day on the farm, so it's up to the girls to make a final impression. The girls then leave and the farmers weigh up their final choice.

videos.overview: The farmers travel to the city to knock on the door of their chosen favourite to see if romance is still alive. They then join host Natalie Gruzlewski on the couch to discuss their choice and reveal if they have indeed found a wife.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
First episode centers on Alex, Dylan, and Jason, who each sat down for a round of speed dates with women who had spotted their profiles online and decided – yes, actually, a man who can perform a bovine rectal palpation with aplomb is exactly what they were looking for.

After the speed dates wrapped and the awkward laughter settled, the three farmers each selected five women to invite back to their farms – the next chapter in a process that is, in equal measure, deeply old-fashioned and oddly moving.
